title: Add data-modeling and appsource knowledge articles (MICROSOFT layer)
summary: Seven remedial BCQuality knowledge articles added to the MICROSOFT layer covering data-modeling patterns, AppSource conventions, and styling best practices, with good and bad AL code examples for each.
key_points: Adds 7 knowledge articles on master-table numbering, the No. Series codeunit, singleton setup tables, Last Date Modified, Blocked checks, ApplicationArea and object affixes
Creates two new domains, data-modeling and appsource; the ApplicationArea article goes in the existing style domain
Each article has a markdown file plus paired good.al and bad.al samples
Articles cite AppSourceCop rules AS0062 and AS0011 and recommend codeunit 310 No. Series over the obsolete-pending NoSeriesManagement (codeunit 396)
Validation reports 199 articles in total with no errors
